card.name: Luanti
card.summary_zh: 可扩展的开源体素游戏引擎，通过游戏包与模组构建不同玩法。
field_notes: 运行平台尚未核定，留空

zh:
Luanti (formerly Minetest)


> Logo 素材作者为 erle，采用 [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/) 许可；详见[固定版本素材许可清单](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/LICENSE.txt)。 Luanti 是一款自由开源的体素游戏引擎，方便制作模组和创建游戏。 版权所有 (C) 2010-2026 Perttu Ahola 及贡献者（参见源文件注释和版本控制日志） 目录 ------------------ 1. [更多文档](#更多文档) 2. [默认控制](#默认控制) 3. [路径](#路径) 4. [配置文件](#配置文件) 5. [命令行选项](#命令行选项) 6. [编译](#编译) 7. [Docker](#docker) 8. [版本方案](#版本方案) 更多文档 ---------------------- - 网站：https://www.luanti.org/ - Luanti 文档：https://docs.luanti.org/ - 论坛：https://forum.luanti.org/ - GitHub：https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/ - [开发者文档](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/tree/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/developing/) - 源代码发行包的 [doc/](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/tree/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/) 目录 默认控制 ---------------- 所有控制都可以通过设置重新绑定。 部分控制可以在设置选项卡的按键配置对话框中更改。 | 按键 | 操作 | |---|---| | 移动鼠标 | 环视 | | W, A, S, D | 移动 | | Space | 跳跃/向上移动 | | Shift | 潜行/向下移动 | | Q | 丢弃物品堆叠 | | Shift + Q | 丢弃单个物品 | | 鼠标左键 | 挖掘/攻击/使用 | | 鼠标右键 | 放置/使用 | | Shift + 鼠标右键 | 建造（不使用） | | I | 物品栏菜单 | | 鼠标滚轮 | 选择物品 | | 0-9 | 选择物品 | | Z | 缩放（需要 zoom 权限） | | T | 聊天 | | / | 命令 | | Esc | 暂停菜单/中止/退出（仅暂停单人游戏） | | + | 增大视距 | | - | 减小视距 | | K | 启用/禁用飞行模式（需要 fly 权限） | | J | 启用/禁用快速模式（需要 fast 权限） | | H | 启用/禁用穿墙模式（需要 noclip 权限） | | E | Aux1（在快速模式下快速移动。游戏可能添加特殊功能） | | C | 切换摄像机模式 | | V | 切换小地图模式 | | Shift + V | 更改小地图方向 | | F1 | 隐藏/显示 HUD | | F2 | 隐藏/显示聊天 | | F3 | 禁用/启用雾 | | F4 | 禁用/启用摄像机更新（禁用后 Mapblock 不再更新；发布构建中禁用） | | F5 | 循环切换调试信息屏幕 | | F6 | 循环切换性能分析信息屏幕 | | F10 | 显示/隐藏控制台 | | F12 | 截图 | 路径 ----- 位置： * `bin` - 编译后的二进制文件 * `share` - 分发的只读数据 * `user` - 用户创建的可修改数据 各平台上的位置： * Windows .zip / RUN_IN_PLACE 源代码： * `bin` = `bin` * `share` = `.` * `user` = `.` * Windows 安装版： * `bin` = `C:\Program Files\Minetest\bin (Depends on the install location)` * `share` = `C:\Program Files\Minetest (Depends on the install location)` * `user` = `%APPDATA%\Minetest` 或 `%MINETEST_USER_PATH%` * Linux 安装版： * `bin` = `/usr/bin` * `share` = `/usr/share/minetest` * `user` = `~/.minetest` 或 `$MINETEST_USER_PATH` * macOS： * `bin` = `Contents/MacOS` * `share` = `Contents/Resources` * `user` = `Contents/User` 或 `~/Library/Application Support/minetest` 或 `$MINETEST_USER_PATH` 世界以独立文件夹形式存放在：`user/worlds/` 配置文件 ------------------ - 默认位置：`user/minetest.conf` - 首次关闭 Luanti 时创建此文件。 - 可通过命令行指定特定文件：`--config ` - 原地运行构建会在 `location_of_exe/../minetest.conf` 和 `location_of_exe/../../minetest.conf` 中查找配置文件。 命令行选项 -------------------- - 使用 `--help` 编译 --------- - [编译 - 通用信息](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/compiling/README.md) - [在 GNU/Linux 上编译](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/compiling/linux.md) - [在 Windows 上编译](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/compiling/windows.md) - [在 MacOS 上编译](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/compiling/macos.md) Docker ------ - [使用 Docker 开发 minetestserver](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/developing/docker.md) - [使用 Docker 运行服务器](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/docker_server.md) 版本方案 -------------- 自 5.0.0-dev 起，我们使用 `major.minor.patch`。此前使用 `0.major.minor`。 - 发行版包含破坏性变更时，主版本号递增，其他数字归零。 - 发行版包含新的非破坏性功能时，次版本号递增，补丁版本号归零。 - 发行版仅包含错误修复和认为必要的非常轻微或琐碎的功能时，补丁版本号递增。 自 5.0.0-dev 和 0.4.17-dev 起，dev 标记表示下一次发布，即 5.0.0-dev 是通向 5.0.0 的开发版本。此前使用 `previous_version-dev`。
en:
Luanti (formerly Minetest)


Luanti is a free open-source voxel game engine with easy modding and game creation. Copyright (C) 2010-2026 Perttu Ahola and contributors (see source file comments and the version control log) Table of Contents ------------------ 1. [Further Documentation](#further-documentation) 2. [Default Controls](#default-controls) 3. [Paths](#paths) 4. [Configuration File](#configuration-file) 5. [Command-line Options](#command-line-options) 6. [Compiling](#compiling) 7. [Docker](#docker) 8. [Version Scheme](#version-scheme) Further documentation ---------------------- - Website: https://www.luanti.org/ - Luanti Documentation: https://docs.luanti.org/ - Forum: https://forum.luanti.org/ - GitHub: https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/ - [Developer documentation](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/tree/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/developing/) - [doc/](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/tree/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/) directory of source distribution Default controls ---------------- All controls are re-bindable using settings. Some can be changed in the key config dialog in the settings tab. | Button | Action | |-------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------| | Move mouse | Look around | | W, A, S, D | Move | | Space | Jump/move up | | Shift | Sneak/move down | | Q | Drop itemstack | | Shift + Q | Drop single item | | Left mouse button | Dig/punch/use | | Right mouse button | Place/use | | Shift + right mouse button | Build (without using) | | I | Inventory menu | | Mouse wheel | Select item | | 0-9 | Select item | | Z | Zoom (needs zoom privilege) | | T | Chat | | / | Command | | Esc | Pause menu/abort/exit (pauses only singleplayer game) | | + | Increase view range | | - | Decrease view range | | K | Enable/disable fly mode (needs fly privilege) | | J | Enable/disable fast mode (needs fast privilege) | | H | Enable/disable noclip mode (needs noclip privilege) | | E | Aux1 (Move fast in fast mode. Games may add special features) | | C | Cycle through camera modes | | V | Cycle through minimap modes | | Shift + V | Change minimap orientation | | F1 | Hide/show HUD | | F2 | Hide/show chat | | F3 | Disable/enable fog | | F4 | Disable/enable camera update (Mapblocks are not updated anymore when disabled, disabled in release builds) | | F5 | Cycle through debug information screens | | F6 | Cycle through profiler info screens | | F10 | Show/hide console | | F12 | Take screenshot | Paths ----- Locations: * `bin` - Compiled binaries * `share` - Distributed read-only data * `user` - User-created modifiable data Where each location is on each platform: * Windows .zip / RUN_IN_PLACE source: * `bin` = `bin` * `share` = `.` * `user` = `.` * Windows installed: * `bin` = `C:\Program Files\Minetest\bin (Depends on the install location)` * `share` = `C:\Program Files\Minetest (Depends on the install location)` * `user` = `%APPDATA%\Minetest` or `%MINETEST_USER_PATH%` * Linux installed: * `bin` = `/usr/bin` * `share` = `/usr/share/minetest` * `user` = `~/.minetest` or `$MINETEST_USER_PATH` * macOS: * `bin` = `Contents/MacOS` * `share` = `Contents/Resources` * `user` = `Contents/User` or `~/Library/Application Support/minetest` or `$MINETEST_USER_PATH` Worlds can be found as separate folders in: `user/worlds/` Configuration file ------------------ - Default location: `user/minetest.conf` - This file is created by closing Luanti for the first time. - A specific file can be specified on the command line: `--config ` - A run-in-place build will look for the configuration file in `location_of_exe/../minetest.conf` and also `location_of_exe/../../minetest.conf` Command-line options -------------------- - Use `--help` Compiling --------- - [Compiling - common information](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/compiling/README.md) - [Compiling on GNU/Linux](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/compiling/linux.md) - [Compiling on Windows](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/compiling/windows.md) - [Compiling on MacOS](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/compiling/macos.md) Docker ------ - [Developing minetestserver with Docker](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/developing/docker.md) - [Running a server with Docker](https://github.com/luanti-org/luanti/blob/9c424c44ff523ebce076367e52222ac4d71e94c1/doc/docker_server.md) Version scheme -------------- We use `major.minor.patch` since 5.0.0-dev. Prior to that we used `0.major.minor`. - Major is incremented when the release contains breaking changes, all other numbers are set to 0. - Minor is incremented when the release contains new non-breaking features, patch is set to 0. - Patch is incremented when the release only contains bugfixes and very minor/trivial features considered necessary. Since 5.0.0-dev and 0.4.17-dev, the dev notation refers to the next release, i.e.: 5.0.0-dev is the development version leading to 5.0.0. Prior to that we used `previous_version-dev`.
